title: {CTW} Western Port

replies.author: Skquid
replies.body:
Hey! Pretty cool map. I do however have some suggestions:
  • Add more texturing with the sandstone. Maybe add bits of regular sand, and if you use upside down sandstone stairs, it gives a cracked sandstone look on the top.
  • Maybe add dead bushes as well, or some leaves to spice up the scenery.
  • Around the edges: consider adding variation to the edge of each island, at the moment it's just plain sandstone.
  • The flooring of the middle structure could use some work. I would use stairs, slabs, and logs to give it more texture and variation.
  • There are a few areas with elevated and depressed terrain, but try to make more dips and hills on the land to give it a better aesthetic look.
  • The amount of gravel and buttons is a bit too low. Consider adding more, and maybe usage of small boulders and minimal usage of cacti could work as well.
So yeah, those are just suggestions, so feel free to argue against them or not implement them. Overall, I think the layout is fine, but the natural aesthetics needs some work.

replies.author: Stuarts
replies.body:
Okay so , for me, this map looks like its in it's early stages. This map could be a lot better:

The wool rooms look kind of broken(uneven) and very easy to be shot in. the cobwebs are a little too wide and should only be there to slowdown players. players will be shot very easily inside especially if their only protection is a diamond helmet. (judging by pics idk if there is an underground).

you could also improve the map by detailing the sides like in ChristmasKoja's map Oasis, wich could enrich the color scheme aswell.

Where you spawn out of i cannot make out what it is supposed to be? a pope's hat? idk x_x

and if you think that all of that would destroy your intended vision of the map..you could then simply add scenery to the map like how the map Sandstorm does by having mountains on the side to enhance the map's vibe. now im not saying to do mountains, but you could enforce the theme/title of the map by adding floating steampunk boats or floating ilands with western town houses ect... (just ideas).

even after what I said, you can see that the map has some effort put into it and for now still has a nice vibe to it. It does indeed have a western vibe wich I love and I find that you did in fact chose the right colors.
and finally I find that unfortunetly the gameplay looks too generic...OK hear me out:
(ofc all maps have some similarities) but this one reminds me too much of Appollo13 D:

So in the end i hope you guys don't see me as someone that's hating on the map >.<
